LanguageData.CH_AutoReform: Select supplies when leaving a site too
LanguageData.CH_AutoReformTip: The game does not select supplies when you reform a caravan. This does.
LanguageData.CH_Days: Without a route, plan for a trip of {0} days
LanguageData.CH_DaysTip: When the caravan has no destination (for example when leaving a site).
LanguageData.CH_Return: Food for the way back too
LanguageData.CH_ReturnTip: When the destination is not your settlement, food for both ways is packed.
LanguageData.CH_NormalMedTip: The game takes the strongest medicine (glitterworld) first. Here ordinary and herbal medicine go, the rare kind stays home.
LanguageData.CH_AddictsTip: Addicted colonists (luciferium, go-juice …) take doses for the whole trip.
LanguageData.CH_Blockers: Show who keeps you from leaving
LanguageData.CH_BlockersTip: A button with everything the game counts as an enemy; click one to jump to it.
LanguageData.CH_LeaveSleeping: Leave past sleeping and hidden enemies
LanguageData.CH_LeaveSleepingTip: You can reform the caravan when no awake, visible, standing enemy is on the map. Sleeping mechanoids, insects in hives, enemies under fog and enemy buildings do not stop you.
LanguageData.CH_WhoBlocksDesc: Everything the game counts as an enemy on this map. Click a name to jump to it.
